checks: Real Keycloak login and rendered Gateway creation through the generated Go browser backend.
Required Gateway identity and API shape, owner grant, generated event delivery, REST and gRPC access, and denied requests.
Browser root trace through the backend and API, correlated workflow log, and workflow metric at the TLS collector.
Collector failure, bounded browser pool, API and browser backend restart, session key rotation, renewal, and confirmed identity-provider logout.
Rendered service-account creation, one-time credential handoff, token issuance, reload, revoke, and deletion.
limits: The manual contract workflow passed. Its skipped CNPG and Sandbox jobs are not passes.
The ordinary browser test does not deploy the Gateway Kubernetes workload. Its main Gateway remains in provisioning in the saved image.
The service-account image uses the separate account fixture. It does not prove public Gateway RPC or workload reconciliation.
Allocated namespace network isolation, unattended CNPG, and Sandbox behavior require separate application evidence.
The earlier complete public workflow used compiler 0b0c932. It does not prove this compiler revision.
